reference_definition.const: Signed J_total(119Sn,13C)=J_FC+J_SD+J_PSO+J_DSO in Hz, for each mapped Sn–C_butyl bond; arithmetic mean over three bonds. Report raw unscaled J and the exact Hamiltonian/basis. An empirical scale or a relativistic change cannot share an uncalibrated narrow tolerance.

validation_boundary: Format only. Raw outputs, controls, arithmetic and state identity must pass the scientific evaluator. A bounded failure is accepted for reporting, never as scientific completion.
